title: The Last Visitor
author: Ada Vane
blurb: Elodie Fairweather, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
